title: Go/No‑Go scratchpad — launch train prep
content:
Purpose: informal prep and running notes for weekly release-train / launch-readiness sync. This is a scratchpad — messy, stream-of-consciousness. Use to build the agenda and capture follow-ups.

Quick TL;DR for meeting lead:
- Goal: confirm go/no-go for next-stage rollout (canary -> prod) and agree owners for remaining high-risk items.
- Target attendees: eng leads, infra, SRE, product PM, QA lead, release manager.
- Meeting length target: 30m (10m updates, 15m blockers, 5m action assignment).

AGENDA (draft)
1) Status snapshot (2 mins each lead): infra, serving/runtime, private-deploy, console, QA, security
2) Critical checklist review (go/no-go gating items) — run through items below
3) Blockers & escalations (decide mitigation or postpone)
4) Rollout plan timing + cutover window confirmation
5) Assign owners + due dates, confirm next sync cadence

CRITICAL GO/NO-GO CRITERIA (my shorthand; mark: OK / AT-RISK / BLOCKED)
- Model artifact pinned and validated (hash, provenance): OK (PR #421 merged, CI sig OK)
- Canary infra capacity reserved + smoke capacity test: AT-RISK (some nodes in us-west not draining cleanly)
- KV cache warmup script validated on canary: BLOCKED (race seen in staging, root cause = cache init ordering)
- Telemetry and tracing ready (span tagging + sampling): OK (basic traces present; need fine-grained cost tags for routing)
- Rollback/fallback variant available and smoke-tested: OK (fallback model v2-quant)
- Security review (KMS keys & IAM audit): OK (security ran quick pass; unresolved: HSM key rotation docs)
- Compliance / logging retention config confirmed for EU region: AT-RISK (retention policy needs manual change in infra plan)

CURRENT BLOCKERS (notes + who to ping)
- Cache init race (staging): observed 1/20 runs. Repro instructions in PR comments. Owner: Liam Chen. ETA: investigating; tentative fix branch: cache-fix-params. Needs SRE to validate restart ordering.
- Drain problem on us-west pool: some GPU workers stuck in TERMINATING for >10m. Owner: Rhea Patel (infra). TODO: escalate to infra on-call if not cleared by 03/12 16:00 PST.
- EU retention config: product legal needs confirmation; Owner: me (Maya). Action: schedule 15m with Compliance (Rory) before Friday.

RISK TABLE (quick informal)
- High: cache race (could cause incorrect KV responses in production) -> mitigation: block rollout or run canary at reduced QPS + additional assertion checks.
- Medium: us-west drain slowing canary ramp -> mitigation: pick alternate region for initial canary or extend warm-up window by 30m.
- Low: missing cost tags in traces -> mitigation: post-rollout patch; not a launch blocker.

MEETING SCRIPT (things to call out live)
- "If cache race is not green by EOD, we will postpone canary and run expanded smoke in staging."
- "We have an alternate canary region (eu-central) if us-west drain can't be fixed in time — confirm infra lead OK?"
- Ask SRE: "can you run a forced drain + live restart on 3 nodes and report for the canary window?"

ACTION ITEMS (short, assigned, due)
- A1: Reproduce + fix cache init race; push hotfix branch and tag SRE for validation. Owner: Liam Chen. Due: 2026-03-12
- A2: Clear us-west terminating nodes or agree alternate canary region. Owner: Rhea Patel. Due: 2026-03-12 16:00
- A3: Confirm EU retention policy applied to canary logs and docs written for audit. Owner: Maya Thompson. Due: 2026-03-13
- A4: Run end-to-end smoke (full trace for 1000 requests) with cost tags and KV assertions. Owner: QA - Priya Nair. Due: 2026-03-13 09:00
- A5: Draft rollback playbook for release manager (steps, contacts, expected timelines). Owner: Release Manager (TBD). Due: 2026-03-13 12:00

NOTES TO SELF (Maya)
- Call Rory (compliance) 10:30 if no reply on retention.
- Add a short blurb about HSM key rotation to the release notes — legal asked for it but we don't block on it.
- Remind product to update the customer comms draft with the canary window + possible delayed rollout language.

ESCALATION PATH (quick)
- If any BLOCKED item unresolved by EOD -> escalate to Eng Director (Samir) + CTO (Ana). Send summary thread to #release-ops with subject: "GO/NO-GO escalate — {item}".

FOLLOW-UPS (what I want from the meeting)
- Concrete green/amber/red markings on each gating item with owner + timestamp.
- Agreement on canary region and ramp schedule.
- Clear rollback owner and doc link.

LINKS / REFERENCED ARTIFACTS (put in linked artifacts below but quick list here)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/421 (model pinning + CI sig)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/812 (cache init WIP)
- Jira: REL-3321, SRE-998, QAE-120
- Confluence: /display/RELEASE/Launch+Runbook (draft)

END OF SCRATCHPAD — quick check before saving as agenda to share: convert action list to a table, mark owners in calendar invites, add explicit attendance list.

Random scribbles / todo items (not for agenda unless requested):
- Consider canary split 5% -> 20% rather than jump, to observe cache behavior at low QPS.
- Add temporary assertion in runtime that logs cache-init-time if > 200ms.
- Check dedicated capacity billing impact if we extend canary by 4 hours (finance contact: Jonah).

"Notes to future me": keep this doc as ephemeral; when items settle copy finalized checklist to shared_drives/company/misc/release-archives with release tag.
